title: docs: document locked folder session behaviour
body:
Add documentation for how Locked Folder access applies to the current session, including the temporary unlock period and visibility of locked assets elsewhere in Immich while the session is elevated.

Refs #30724, #29690, #26185.

## Description

<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
Added some basic documentation for the behaviour of the locked folder.  Specifically I was surprised to see locked folder items showing up in my `Utilities -> Largest Files` and found a couple of issues mentioning similar behaviour but no documentation.  It was an "intermittent" observation based upon whether I had unlocked the locked folder, but not obvious that this unlocking extends to other functionality in Immich, so I think explicit documentation would help here.

Relates to #30724, #29690, #26185.

## How Has This Been Tested?

N/A - documentation only

ChatGPT pointed me to a couple of resolved issues that didn't document this behaviour.  Also used it to check my new file was readable and understandable by an LLM (ChatGPT) so anyone else asking this question doesn't need to create new issues.
